blockingIssues.description: Documentation claims hooks/useGroups.ts and hooks/useExpenses.ts exist but these files DO NOT EXIST in the codebase. The documentation even shows code examples claiming these files exist (lines ~245-260), which is false documentation that will mislead users.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Missing logger.go in middleware directory structure. logger.go exists at backend/internal/middleware/logger.go and implements StructuredLogger/RecoveryWithLogger but is not documented.
Documentation shows 'pwa/register.ts' but actual file is 'pwa/pwaGuide.ts'.
Incomplete modals documentation - only 5 modals listed when 17 files exist in modals/ directory.
Missing files from components documentation: ToastContext.ts and components/hooks/useSwipeableModal.ts.
Missing auth/_internal/context.ts file from auth directory documentation.
Missing files from directory structure: types.ts, Fonts.tsx, mock/api.ts, mock/data.ts.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: docs-verifier skill should emphasize verifying file existence for every path mentioned in documentation, not just fixing incorrect names. Add explicit step to grep/check that all documented file paths actually exist in the codebase.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker left useGroups.ts and useExpenses.ts in hooks/ documentation without checking if these files actually exist. Transcript shows grep for localStorage/sessionStorage patterns but no verification that hooks files exist.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: When documenting directory structures, all files should be listed exhaustively, not just a subset. This ensures documentation accuracy and prevents misleading partial information.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: modals/ directory has 17 files but only 5 are documented in FRONTEND.md, leading to incomplete and potentially misleading documentation.
